gen-gf-paprika-gf-noto-sans-georgian: Paprika's lowercase fills the line like capitals, loud and widely spaced. Noto Sans Georgian sits underneath with open curves and short ascender stems, giving the shouting above somewhere quiet to rest.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-noto-sans-grantha: Noto Sans Grantha has tall little letters, set against commanding Paprika. Noto Sans Grantha never snags on a closed bowl, so its sans-serif text runs on smoothly for as long as needed.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-noto-sans-gurmukhi: Noto Sans Gurmukhi reads crisply, its terminals flicking outward like tongs. What stands out most is the range: Paprika shouts in capital-sized lowercase while the body keeps its ascenders barely above the x-height.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-noto-sans-hebrew: Big, loud, hollow-hearted: Paprika fills the line with capital-sized lowercase and counters that breathe like a cut reed. Noto Sans Hebrew, with its dominant midsection, takes the quiet seat below.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-noto-sans-hk: Paprika sets its lowercase at capital height, with counters that breathe like a cut reed. While Paprika is built to command attention, Noto Sans HK is built to read, its brush ends lifting away before curves close.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-noto-sans-imperial-ara: Loud and wide-set: Paprika lets lowercase forms stand nearly as tall as capitals, filling every line it touches. Noto Sans Imperial Aramaic then carries on approachably, paragraph after paragraph, without tiring.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-noto-sans-kaithi: Paprika arrives loud, its lowercase filling the line like capitals. The best thing here is the gap in voice: Noto Sans Kaithi speaks plainly through open-channeled e shapes while Paprika declaims.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-noto-sans-kannada: Big, brash, and hollow-cored: that's Paprika. Noto Sans Kannada follows with s curves open wide at both ends and a gentle bump up to capitals, approachable where Paprika is loud.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-noto-sans-khojki: Paprika fills the line with capital-sized lowercase and hollow counters. Noto Sans Khojki gives it a counterweight, its wide exits and large e eyes letting light through beneath all that volume.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-noto-sans-khudawadi: Counters on Paprika breathe like a hollow reed cut open, and its lowercase nearly matches capital height. Noto Sans Khudawadi, with rounds left unsealed like an unlatched hook, keeps the text moving gently, line after line.
